How many persons speak either Gujarati or Marathi but not both?
solution:
From the given diagram,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9579987c30fd1bc1030cbc0f24de76c00c8550e1d9b72e0504e6f61df9b1706.png] 

The shaded part represents the persons who speak either Gujarati or Marathi but not both.

= 68 + 72 + 26 + 17

= 183

Hence, "183" is the correct answer.
